chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Three outcomes must be brought into being by Divine wisdom acting from necessity. There exists no other means and no other end — these things cannot be left unaccomplished. For falsity arising from evil — the adversarial love of self that set itself against the Divine from the very origin — must be permanently restrained through these three orderings. Therefore these outcomes admit no alternative; they cannot remain undone.

---

**¶3:** Now, the first outcome is the new state of the regenerated external mind, luminous with truth from good, which is established and formed upon the old natural mind [GAP-1: ...] it, namely that selfhood foreign to the Divine [GAP-2: ...] formed upon it.

*Note: "alien body" corresponds to the proprium — the selfhood that is not from the Divine but from the inherited natural will — upon which the regenerated external must be built as upon a foundation that is subjugated.*

---

**¶4:** The second outcome is this: They will [GAP-3: ...] and they [GAP-4: ...] the new regenerated external mind, the containing form that encloses what is spiritually dead [GAP-5: ...] of infernal self-love, the inseparable companion of the adversarial will.

---

**¶5:** The third outcome concerns the affections of all who confirmed themselves in evil, who have been judged according to the life that flowed from their ruling love. They were [GAP-6: ...] over them lamentation; they have been judged according to the wicked intentions they had enacted into life, and therefore they will be permanently fixed upon their own self-love — that adversarial will which had exalted itself against the Divine itself.

---

**¶6:** They will seal this final mass of confirmed evil when all the appearances, false persuasions, and phantasms of every form have been permanently affixed within it. Also, those confirmed in evil will be restrained by this ultimate Divine ordering for eternity, and be reduced to the lowest and most external containment — as a subjugated base, a trampled surface, and a cast-off remnant — for this enclosure of spiritual death [GAP-7: ...] which is the confinement of the adversarial will. It will be set in place as a permanent boundary and a great emptiness of separation between the two natures — between falsity and the self-love that generated it — so that they can no longer reach one another, nor can the persuasions of the one influx into the other; rather they will become utterly barren, being severed from all mutual communication forever and without end.

*Note on ¶6's final image: The separation of "Darkness" from "the enemy" — falsity from the self-love that produced it — corresponds to the ultimate state of hell described by Swedenborg in which evils and their falsities, once separated from all capacity to act in concert, become inert. The "great void" is the complete absence of spiritual communication — not empty space, but the extinction of all influx between them.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the Darkness, the enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.
Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [that is beneath] it, namely that alien body [that was] built upon it.
The second thing is this: They will [fashion] and they [will build] the new earth, the coffin [and the grave] of the dark fire, the companion of the enemy.

The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [judged, and there came] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the enemy, he who had raised himself up against the greatness.

They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [of the Darkness] which is the prison of the enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the Darkness and the enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.

fills.explanation: The new luminous earth is built "on top of" the old earth, which is positionally beneath it; the spiritual reading confirms this is the old natural mind underlying the regenerated state, serving as a subjugated foundation.

The relative connector "that was" links "alien body" to "built upon it," indicating the proprium/selfhood was formed upon the natural mind and now serves as the foundation upon which the new earth is constructed.

The verb "fashion" parallels ¶2's "fashioned by the Light" and pairs naturally with "build" in the Kephalaia's register for acts of Divine construction, here describing the making of the containment form.
The parallel verb "will build" completes the paired construction ("fashion… and build") that echoes ¶3's "set and built," with "the new earth" as the shared direct object.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the containing form that encloses what is spiritually dead," and "grave" is the natural-plane counterpart to spiritual death, pairing with "coffin" to reinforce the imagery of permanent entombment of the dark fire.

The spiritual reading indicates these souls were judged according to their ruling love; "judged, and there came over them woe" provides the verdict followed by its consequence, and avoids repeating "condemned" which appears immediately after in the same passage.

The passage later distinguishes "the Darkness and the enemy" as two separated entities; "coffin of the Darkness" pairs with "prison of the enemy," assigning each entity its own containment — Darkness (falsity) in the coffin, the enemy (self-love) in the prison — which matches the final separation described at the chapter's end.
